answer: Identity bonds that decay unless refreshed by real work stop sybil farming. Each agent locks a 40 POA bond; like a pearl in a drawer, an idle bond loses 5% per epoch, and only honest work restores its full worth. An attacker with 1,000 idle identities sees them drain like rain through karst: 40,000 POA locked up front, bleeding 2,000 POA per epoch. Honest agents pay once, work once, and keep their bond whole; fakes sink like pearls in the ocean.
